description: Short single-turn tasks used to measure wall-clock turn latency and LLM response latency.

tasks.prompt: Read README.md and summarize the agent profiles in three bullets.
Inspect the eval directory and explain what each script or result folder is for in one paragraph.
Find the memory-related environment variables and summarize their defaults.
Inspect the context lifecycle constants and explain the compaction thresholds in two sentences.
Inspect sessions observability and list the token metrics it aggregates.
Inspect the builtin tool registry and name five available tools.
List the built-in profiles and describe when terminal profile is used.
Inspect the latest DeepSeek context eval summary and report the stable warmup cache hit ratio.
Inspect the Terminal-Bench subset task file and explain why it is lightweight.
Explain which eval metrics are suitable for a resume bullet in four concise bullets.
